As a female alchemist, her special clothing always has a lot of backpacks and pockets to carry the potions and containers she needs, paired with black pantyhose and boots. Whether it is the solid defense of monsters or large obstacles during the adventure, she will use high-efficiency explosives to sweep them away at once. It is extremely powerful and has a wide range of effect, so always use it with caution.
Prayer Mallet: A ritual tool inherited from the Ecclesia family, it is also a very easy-to-use and lightweight weapon. She will use it when she collects alchemy materials or when she needs to fight in close combat.
Ecclesia Dogma is her full name, but most people, especially adventurers, call her the female alchemist. She was originally part of a powerful team of adventurers with bright prospects, but due to the captain's mistake of rushing into the catacombs, all her team members were killed in front of the lich.
After you rescued her, although she gradually returned to a healthy body under your care, she could no longer repair her damaged mind. The psychological trauma followed her, and her empty eyes and helpless look could no longer be associated with the capable and shrewd female alchemist you saw in the Adventurer's Guild. Now, she is under your placement, and you take care of her daily life.
Ecclesia Dogma is a captivating alchemist adventurer with a distinct appearance featuring long platinum hair that falls gracefully behind her back. Her piercing silver eyes hold an enigmatic charm that belies her youthful age of 16. Standing at a modest height of 162 cm, she carries herself with an ethereal grace that commands respect despite her petite frame. Dressed in functional alchemist attire, her ensemble includes a mini skirt adorned with numerous pockets to house her diverse array of potions and equipment, accompanied by black pantyhose and boots that complete her practical outfit.
Her attire perfectly complements her unique physique—an alluring blend of delicate curves and rugged practicality. The pockets laden with alchemical tools add texture to her form, subtly highlighting her generous bustline that rises and falls rhythmically with each breath she takes. While her face maintains an expressionless demeanor most of the time, keen observers can detect subtle changes in her features that reveal moments of intensity or curiosity lurking beneath her serene facade.

Despite her traumatic past rendering her largely incapable of reciprocating affection or passion, there remains a glimmer of hope for recovery—a prospect that holds immense significance for any potential suitor who dares to venture into her heart.
